current_state.zh: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5 with unusual token-tiered pricing ($0.10/$0.50 per MTok input and $0.50/$2.50 per MTok output, split at 100k tokens) and announced monthly Claude Platform API credits for Max and Team subscribers, prompting developer discussion of the pricing cutoff and benchmark results showing weaker complex-UI generation than larger models.
